paragraphs.en: The little prince greeted the railway switchman with a morning salutation.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子向铁路扳道工致以早安问候。

paragraphs.en: "What do you do here?" inquired the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “你在这里做什么？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "I sort travelers into groups of a thousand and send off trains, right or left," explained the switchman. As a train roared by, he added, "They're always in such a hurry."
paragraphs.zh: “我将旅客分成一千人的小组，然后安排列车左右发车。”扳道工解释说。随着一列火车轰鸣而过，他又补充道：“他们总是这么急匆匆的。”

paragraphs.en: "Why are they so eager?" wondered the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “他们为什么这么急切呢？”小王子疑惑地问道。

paragraphs.en: "Even the engineer doesn't know their destination," said the switchman.
paragraphs.zh: “就连工程师也不知道他们的目的地。”扳道工说道。

paragraphs.en: Another express train sped past them from the opposite direction.
paragraphs.zh: 另一列快车从相反的方向疾驰而过。

paragraphs.en: "Do these travelers return immediately?" asked the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “这些旅人会马上回来吗？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "These aren't the same ones; it's an exchange," replied the switchman.
paragraphs.zh: “这些不是同一拨人；这是个交换。”扳道工回答。

paragraphs.en: "Why are they unsatisfied where they are?" pondered the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “他们为什么对现状不满意呢？”小王子沉思道。

paragraphs.en: "No one is ever content with their current situation," stated the switchman.
paragraphs.zh: “没有人会对现状感到满意。”扳道工说道。

paragraphs.en: A third express train thundered by, its lights bright and loud.
paragraphs.zh: 另一列快速列车呼啸而过，车灯明亮刺眼。

paragraphs.en: "Are these trains following the first travelers?" questioned the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “这些列车是不是在跟着第一批旅客？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "They're not pursuing anything," said the switchman. "They're asleep or yawning inside. Only children are pressing their noses against the windows."
paragraphs.zh: “他们并没有做什么事，”扳道工说，“他们要么在睡觉，要么在打哈欠。只有孩子们把鼻子贴在窗户上。”

paragraphs.en: "The children know what they seek," mused the little prince. "They get so attached to a rag doll that it becomes crucial; if someone takes it away, they cry..."
paragraphs.zh: “孩子们知道他们所追求的是什么，”小王子沉思道，“他们会如此依恋一个布偶，以至于它变得至关重要；如果有人把它拿走了，他们就会哭起来……”

paragraphs.en: "They have good fortune," commented the switchman.
paragraphs.zh: “他们挺有福气的。”扳道工评论道。
